title: Lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD000'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFA500'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id='soft'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='1.2'/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <!-- soft outer glow -->
  <path d='M56 8 L30 54 H46 L38 92 L70 42 H52 L56 8 Z'
        fill='#FFB300' opacity='0.35' filter='url(#soft)' transform='translate(0,1)'/>
  <!-- main bolt body -->
  <path d='M56 8 L30 54 H46 L38 92 L70 42 H52 L56 8 Z'
        fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- lighter inner highlight on the upper segment -->
  <path d='M56 8 L40 42 H50 L44 60 L58 30 H50 L56 8 Z'
        fill='#FFF3A0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- warm inner glow on the lower segment -->
  <path d='M46 54 L42 78 L58 46 H50 L46 54 Z'
        fill='#FFF7B0' opacity='0.65'/>
  <!-- crisp top edge highlight -->
  <path d='M56 8 L34 50' stroke='#FFFDE0' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- cute little shine dots -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='18' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='66' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
